I have this mockup from ChatGPT and I want a scene in Blender that looks exactly like this, box-shaped object with a nice slit close to the edge. I want the final product to be a Blender file with the scene rigged and nice lighting so I can instantly export the scene as an image.You don't have to design the actual cover of the product, but please deliver the product with some cover so I can see how it looks like in the render, and I need instructions for how I can easily change the texture/cover to my own.The idea is to have a scene where I can write a Python script to generate 100s of these product renderings but with different textures on the model. text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — passionate, hard-working, and ready to help build your Blender product mock-up scene.

I have 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning tools, and I’ve also built product recommendation systems for Tidewater Outfitters using Python, PyTorch, and AWS SageMaker. That project created similar-items and “you-may-also-like” carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and improved click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test.

For your Blender scene, I can help set up a clean, reusable product mock-up with lighting, a box-shaped model, and an easy way to swap textures or text for batch renders. I’d also make sure the file is structured so you can automate it with Python as needed.

Would you like the product text to be driven by a simple script-ready placeholder system, or do you prefer texture swapping as the main workflow?
